Repair the analytical model contract: establish grain and source keys, handle late/corrected records without double counting, define the revenue metric once, add lineage and data tests, and demonstrate that incremental and full-refresh results reconcile for a supplied seven-day slice. Product funnel interpretation is explicitly out of scope; preserve that boundary with product-analytics.
